Name: Quick Stash
Author: ChiroxT
Description:
Since [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9624]Stash Items[/url] by Synvert seem to not get updates anymore, i updated it to 1.6 :)


[u][b]How it Works:[/b][/u]

Press 'R' to stash your items from your inventory to nearby chests.

Radius and Key are configurable.
